description: Permanently deletes a specific check item from a checklist on a Trello card; this operation is irreversible and only affects the specified item, not the entire checklist.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for deleting a specific check item from a checklist.

idCheckItem.description: The ID of the check item to be deleted.
idCheckItem.title: Id Check Item

idChecklist.description: The ID of the checklist that contains the check item to be deleted.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

inputSchema.title: DeleteChecklistItemRequest

name: delete_checklist_item

DeleteChecklistItemResponse.description: Response schema for DELETE checkItem endpoint. Returns a minimal response with limits info upon successful deletion (HTTP 200).

limits.description: Rate limit information returned by Trello API. Usually an empty object on successful deletion.
limits.title: Limits
